erpnext_document_sequence.action: create revisioned assembly and child item codes from bom.csv; link physical candidate and evaluation IDs
resolve child quantities, materials, supplier approvals, mass and cost before submission
assign controlled instructions, stations and shop times from routing.csv; replace allowances with measured process time
request one installed unit price, lead time, local process content and replacement price for each unresolved qualified package
issue only after supplier and drawing approval
receive serial or lot and attach certificates and measured incoming inspection
apply approved numerical limits and record instrument, inspector, measurement, disposition and nonconformance
release exact candidate and revision against approved BOM, routing and available accepted stock
record exact car, beam, bearing, door and power-site position with serial or lot and as-built datum
link defect, isolation, removed serial, repair or replacement, retest and independent handback

inspection_plan.measurement_required: each finished car and axle on calibrated scales

inspection_plan.characteristic: motor bogie brake and hose finite sweeps
inspection_plan.measurement_required: full yaw roll heave wear tool and supported removal paths

inspection_plan.characteristic: HV insulation earth cooling and independent brake
inspection_plan.measurement_required: cold and repeated-hot duty plus loss-of-power and one-module-out
complete 0.72m slide hypothesis, obstruction, seal, tool and removal envelopes
batch strength, cover, seat survey, mass, lift plan, deflection and bearing travel
grid fault duty, 1.5kV insulation, heat rejection, earthing, isolation and removal path

repair_sequence: Identify installation position, candidate, revision and serial or lot.
Create defect and lock out overhead, traction DC, auxiliary battery, brake stored energy and coolant as applicable.
Support component and inspect finite removal route, lifting capacity and access.
Remove and record old serial; inspect interface and repair or fit approved replacement.
Record new serial, joins, fastener torque, seal, cable/hose routing and as-built datum.
Repeat applicable measured retention, insulation, leakage, brake and functional tests; obtain independent handback.
